author: deepseek-3.2
brief: Phase: implementation (a feature in existing code). Role: developer. Repo kind: a Python 3.12 library (standard library only) that evaluates feature flags from a JSON file for a web service, with a loader, an evaluator, a context object, tests, CI config and docs. About 25 files. Inspiration (idea only): public feature-flag clients with percentage rollout that buckets a user by hashing the user id with the flag name so a user keeps the same answer. Build a task where the owner asks for percentage rollout with overrides, with wrinkles of your own design (a stable hash that does not depend on Python's per-process hash seed, rollout that only grows when the percentage rises, an allowlist and denylist that win over the percentage, missing user ids, and a dry-run report of how many of a sample of ids are on).
